description: This file is a Perl test script using Test2 and Test::Coocook modules to test the 'recipes of the day' feature, involving database resultsets and web page content verification.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A testing class providing methods for web and database testing related to the Coocook application.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Test::Coocook object.

methods.name: get_ok
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and checks for success.

methods.name: text_unlike
methods.description: Checks that the response text does not match a given regex.

methods.name: resultset
methods.description: Retrieves a specific resultset from the schema.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new record in the database.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Retrieves all records from a resultset.

methods.name: format_date_today
methods.description: Formats the current date for the 'RecipeOfTheDay' record.

methods.name: reload_ok
methods.description: Reloads the page and checks for success.

methods.name: text_like
methods.description: Checks that the response text matches a given regex.

methods.name: text_contains
methods.description: Checks that the response text contains a specific string.

methods.name: follow_link_ok
methods.description: Follows a link with specified text and checks for success.

methods.name: base_like
methods.description: Checks that the base URL matches a regex.
